action_items: EvidencePicker.jsx: the filename rendered inside <option> is wrapped by the VE-dynamic tooling in a <span>, producing invalid HTML and a React console warning. Consider rendering the filename as plain text {f.filename} without a wrapping element so the ve-dynamic span is not injected inside <option>.
Admin panel horizontal overflow at 390px — not part of this iteration's scope but worth checking after dialog usability pass.
critical_code_review_comments: case_records.py: ledger POST sort is by (date asc, created_at asc) so a pago on 2025-02-10 lands before a cargo on 2025-02-28; balance is accumulated chronologically and the exported table reflects this. Confirmed by tests (feb_pago balance = 1000, final saldo 5500).
case_records.py _store_file(): accepts a stored_name only if it already appears in _evidence(case_id); good defense against cross-case file reuse.
case_bundle._annex_pdf(): wraps PdfReader() in try/except so a corrupt PDF falls back to the cover sheet with a soporte digital note — verified with raw bytes 'not a real pdf'.
case_bundle._foliate(): two-pass; computes page sizes first, then stamps 'Folio N de T' bottom-right with a white background. Works on heterogeneous page sizes (image annex, pdf annex).

case_bundle._front(): uses placeholder '000 - 000' to count front pages first, then rebuilds with real folio ranges — correct way to avoid chicken-and-egg counting. Note: if the front page count changes between the dummy and real render (e.g. a long title that wraps differently when the folio ranges are wider than '000 - 000'), the front page count could drift by 1 and foliate would still work but the index numbers would be off. Edge case, unlikely with short ranges.
consulting.delete_case (line 467-471): correctly cascades to case_ledger, case_facts, case_events, case_messages. Verified by test_delete_case_cleans_records.

case_records._store_file() / add_ledger_entry: the first dated entry in a recurring cargo attaches the uploaded file; subsequent repeats have file=None. Reasonable default but not documented to the UI.
EvidencePicker option contains ve-dynamic <span> (invalid HTML inside <option>) — console hydration warning.
